rule dac_gcp_0024 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GCP: KMS CryptoKeyVersion destroy or disable - DestroyCryptoKeyVersion"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GCP-0024"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1485"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDAUDIT"
    (($e.metadata.product_event_type = "DestroyCryptoKeyVersion" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "DisableCryptoKeyVersion" nocase) or $e.metadata.product_event_type = /DestroyCryptoKey/ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
